name: Necromancer: Animate: Frost Wyrm does not reuse Skeletal Mage's Command spell (#4536)
contract: Animate: Frost Wyrm 805428 reads 'flies behind the Necromancer that blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec ... Frost damage', a periodic aura-driven attack (807339) with no Command effect of its own, unlike every other Raise/Animate line. AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp's AttackSpell(entry) previously mapped creature 50177 (Frost Wyrm) to 801513, the exact same id as case 50075 (Skeletal Mage's own 'Command: Skeletal Mage'), so DoAction's default branch ('case 50177' fallthrough to 'default: if (uint32 ability = AttackSpell(entry)) Cast(me, target, ability)') cast 801513 on the Command target whenever Command: Undead (504868, which every non-stationary minion responds to) was used, even with no Skeletal Mage out. The fix removes the 50177 case so AttackSpell(50177) returns 0 and DoAction's default branch instead self-casts the harmless 504022, discriminated here by 801513's own SMSG_SPELL_GO (SpellVisual 1000228) never being sent by the Frost Wyrm.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
CONTROL: no Command: Skeletal Mage cast yet
Command: Undead on the golem, only a Frost Wyrm is out
Allow any wrongly-triggered cast to arrive
DISCRIMINATING: the Frost Wyrm never casts Skeletal Mage's Command spell
The Frost Wyrm is still alive and out
